plugins.name: koin-migration
plugins.description: Automate Dependency Injection (DI) framework migration to Koin 4.x with the Koin Compiler Plugin. Supports Hilt, Dagger, Toothpick, Kodein, Koin DSL upgrades, and KSP-to-Compiler-Plugin migration.

metadata.description: Official Koin skills by the Koin team: set up Koin, write Koin code, migrate from other DI frameworks, and diagnose Koin apps with Kotzilla.
